doc.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017

title: Finding gigs and leading his own band
summary: Work comes by word of mouth; as a leader he could choose what to play.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: So in the last twenty or thirty years for you, do you mostly wait for the phone to ring as far as gigs?

Sometimes. Yeah. Sometimes. But sometimes — music is funny. It’s a lot of heads you’re playing here or heads you’re playing there or somebody recommends you to out there, and different situations happen like that.
Did you ever be a band leader?
And then you have to go out and find the gigs, right?
Yeah. It was all right. Because then you get to dictate what you want to play you know, mostly.
